title: CompatZ
body:
A 1.20.1 Datapack that adds LevelZ support for:
- Better Nether
- Better End
- Additional Additions
- Galosphere
- Advanced Netherite
- Deeper Darker
- Farmer's Delight
- More Vanilla Shields
- Stoneworks
- Promenade
- Cinderscapes
- Philip's Ruins
- Regions Unexplored (excluding nether blocks, as the RU nether biomes seem to conflict with BN)
- Wilder Wild
- Friends and Foes
- Simple Copper Pipes (Lunade)
- Better Archeology
- Nether Depths Upgrade
- Terrestria
- Inmis
- Hybrid Aquatic
- AdventureZ (mainly the items)

Note: Adds armor, tool, block, farming, and potion level restrictions when nessecary. The level requirements should be customizable (in the item/block/armor's respective json file).

Please make any suggestions or post issues on the curseforge!

(also yes that is a picture of my dog because i couldn't think of a good pack icon)
